capabilities: Draw vector handwriting annotations over rendered Markdown
Separate stylus input from finger scrolling and pinch zoom
Map pen side buttons to toggle pen and eraser
Persist strokes per note with autosave and smart merge
Re-anchor strokes to Markdown blocks when text changes
disambiguation: It does not convert handwriting to text; it stores strokes as vector ink data anchored to Markdown blocks.
extras: Beta release (0.1.0-beta.1); strokes and metadata are stored in a separate data directory (default Attachments/Handwriting/) rather than inside the note body.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand-write or draw vector annotations on top of a Markdown note alongside its edit and reading views.
summary: Handwriting annotation view that layers vector ink strokes over rendered Markdown notes, with pen/touch separation and stroke persistence.
